Every IT change and purchase that could affect the emergency plan or plant security must also pass the 10 CFR 73.58 safety/security interface screening
An enterprise risk assessment must be performed at least annually and after major changes, using NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1
Risk acceptance authority: Risk owners may accept Low and Very Low risks; the Site Vice President, Moderate; the CEO, High for up to 12 months with a dated plan
Cyber security program deficiencies found by IT, the MSSP, or assessors must be entered in the corrective action program within 24 hours of discovery when...
The vCISO must report to the audit committee each quarter on top risks, POA&M status, incidents, and roadmap progress
Security policies must be reviewed at least annually and after major changes or incidents; standards annually by their owners
Vendors: No vendor may connect to the business network or receive Restricted or Confidential data without a security review scaled to its tier, contract...
Security controls must be independently assessed at least annually (P07)
Records that support CSP decisions (evaluations, tickets, logs used as evidence) must be retained until license termination, with superseded versions kept...
AI tools must be approved through the AI governance process before use (STD-05; P10)
Workforce members who violate security policies are subject to sanctions under the HR disciplinary policy; behavior of concern is also reported to the...
Every user must have a unique account
Accounts are created only from an approved request or the HR feed, disabled on the HR termination date, and changed on transfer the same day, including...
MFA is required for all remote access, email, cloud, and SaaS access, and for every administrator logon including site console logons
Privileged access: No standing domain administrator rights
Access reviews: each quarter for privileged accounts, the WMS, CAP/EDMS, the access authorization enclave, and GDSR; at least annually for all other access
Vendor remote access: Vendors connect only through named, time-limited accounts on the privileged access broker, with MFA and session recording, enabled per...
People whose duties let them act electronically on systems that could adversely impact safety, security, or EP must be in the access authorization program...
Access authorization files and other Restricted personal information are administered only by named enclave administrators; domain administrators have no...
Break-glass accounts: two per critical system, sealed offline, tested quarterly, and reviewed after every use
Service account passwords must be vaulted and rotated at least annually and when an administrator with knowledge of them leaves
The company must maintain integrated runbooks for its most likely and most harmful incidents: a business network attack with an attempted pivot toward CDAs,...
Workforce members must report suspected incidents immediately (within 1 hour at most) to the service desk security line or the MSSP
Every incident must be logged with the date and time of discovery and tracked to closure
Escalation to the CST and the Shift Manager: The incident commander must call the Cyber Security Program Manager (or the CST on-call) and the Shift Manager...

If the corrective action program is unavailable, 73.77(b) entries are recorded on numbered paper CAP intake forms within 24 hours and entered when CAP is...
A severity 1 incident must activate the crisis management team within 2 hours
General Counsel keeps the notification decision log: Florida breach determination and 30-day clock, NRC, NERC, contract, and insurer notices
Any ransom payment needs the CEO, counsel, the insurer, an OFAC sanctions check, and a report to law enforcement
Business systems are restored in the order set by the BIA (P05), and recovery of the WMS and CAP/EDMS must be tested at least annually and before each...
The incident response plans must be exercised at least annually with IT, the CST, the Shift Manager, and the MSSP together; the NERC low-impact plan at...
Logs needed to investigate incidents must be collected from all PBN-WMS components, including WMS, EDMS, CAP, and the receive server (STD-02)
Classes: (1) Safeguards Information (10 CFR 73.21-73.22): handled only under the SGI program, never on the business network or in the cloud
SGI may be processed only on the stand-alone SGI computers or other NRC-approved systems, stored in locked security containers, marked on the top and bottom...
Restricted information is stored only in EDMS restricted folders or the access authorization enclave, carries a sensitivity label, and is protected by DLP...
Restricted and Confidential data must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2 or higher) and at rest
Business systems must be backed up daily to the recovery account with write-once retention, and CSP-supporting records copied monthly to long-term retention
Portable media and mobile devices are assigned to one security level
Media are sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse, with certificates
Restricted-folder access is reviewed each quarter, and general shares are searched quarterly for misplaced Restricted documents
Company systems are for authorized business use; users have no expectation of privacy on them, and activity is monitored
Never connect a personal or business device, cable, or USB drive to any plant equipment, control panel, or CDA
Never install software or remote access tools, or connect unapproved devices or wireless access points to the business network
Never place SGI or Restricted information on general shares, personal storage, personal email, or external sites
Use only approved AI tools (the approved-tools list kept by the vCISO)
Complete security awareness training: annually for employees and long-term contractors, and the outage contractor module (including PMMD and SRI content)...
Report suspected phishing, lost devices, or unusual system behavior immediately (POL-03 4.2)
Lock screens when away and protect badges and credentials; never share them
